scripts.generate: cargo build --locked -p covalence-repl --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/covalence_repl.wasm --out-dir generated --out-name nucleus --target web
scripts.generate:web-beta-spike: cargo build --locked --release -p covalence-hol-proof-guest-web-beta --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/covalence_hol_proof_guest_web_beta.wasm --out-dir generated/web-beta --out-name guest --target web
scripts.test:web-beta-spike: pnpm run generate && pnpm run generate:web-beta-spike && node --test test/web-beta-spike.mjs
